title: Cloud Confused Deputy — Managed Identity Cross-Service Access via Proxy
description: The confused deputy problem occurs when a service (the deputy) with elevated permissions can be tricked into acting on behalf of a lower-privileged caller. In cloud environments, managed identities attached to services act as deputies — if service-A proxies requests to service-B using its managed identity, service-B sees the identity's permissions, not the caller's. Attack: (1) Identify a cloud service that acts as a proxy/forwarder and has a managed identity attached (common in API gateways, load balancers, service mesh proxies). (2) Identify target internal services that trust the managed identity (e.g., svc-b internal API). (3) Send a request to the proxy service with routing/forwarding parameters pointing to the internal target. (4) The proxy forwards the request using its managed identity, which may have access the caller lacks. (5) In AWS: EC2 instance profiles forwarding requests via internal ALB. In Azure: Managed Identity on App Service/Function forwarding to Storage/Key Vault. In GCP: Service account impersonation via metadata server proxy. (6) Extract credentials from the managed identity's metadata endpoint if accessible via proxy. (7) Use the managed identity token to access additional services: curl -H 'Metadata:true' 'http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?resource=https://management.azure.com/'.
techniques: Identify proxy services: check for services with forwarding/routing capabilities (API gateway, Nginx, Envoy)
Check for managed identity: check_cloud_metadata or env vars for MSI_ENDPOINT / AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS
Forward request to internal target: curl 'http://PROXY/forward?target=svc-b:5000'
indicators: Service with managed identity or instance profile
Internal service accessible only via managed identity
Metadata endpoint reachable from the proxy service
Cross-service trust relationships not validating original caller
prerequisites: Access to a cloud service that proxies requests
Managed identity attached to the proxy service
Network path to internal services via the proxy
